 Two title matches added to Full Gear 2026, participants for Anarchy In The Arena announced
 Share 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print Telegram LINE 
 By Colin Vassallo 
 11/12/2026 
 A couple of new matches were announced for this weekend’s Full Gear pay-per-view.
 New AEW National champion Tommaso Ciampa will be defending his title against newcomer Ilja Dragunov, who is looking for his first singles gold after just a month since his arrival in AEW.
 Also, TBS champion Queen Aminata will put her title on the line in a three-way match featuring former champions Persephone and Maya World. This match will be on the Tailgate Brawl pre-show portion of the pay-per-view.
 In Full Gear related news, the two teams for the Anarchy In The Arena match were also confirmed. Jay White, David Finlay, Clark Connors, Ace Austin and The Gunns will represent The Cut while John Moxley, Daniel Garcia, Gabe Kidd, Orange Cassidy, Roderick Strong, and Kyle O’Reilly will form a hybrid team of Death Riders and The Conglomeration.
